diagrams.title: One training step is a feedback loop
diagrams.caption: The prediction moves forward; information about the error moves backward; the next step uses updated parameters.

diagrams.title: Broadcasting aligns dimensions from the right
diagrams.caption: A dimension can match exactly or have size 1. The size-1 values are reused virtually; PyTorch does not tile the tensor in memory.

diagrams.title: Raw files become tensor contracts in stages
diagrams.caption: Decoding, layout conversion, numeric scaling, and normalization are separate transformations. Keeping them separate makes mistakes observable.

diagrams.title: The optimizer owns the update, not the experiment
diagrams.caption: The loop must still create predictions, calculate loss, clear gradients, and invoke backward in the correct order.

stages.label: zero_grad
stages.detail: discard gradients from the previous step

visual.label: Illustrative loss decreases over optimization steps

diagrams.title: Activation choice changes the gradient signal
diagrams.caption: These illustrative local slopes show why forward values alone are not enough. Inspect both activation outputs and gradients over the input range used by the model.

stages.label: Input
stages.detail: sample negative, zero, and positive values

visual.label: Illustrative activation gradient magnitude near representative inputs

diagrams.title: Training, validation, and test answer different questions
diagrams.caption: Only the training partition updates parameters. Validation selects choices; the reserved test split estimates the final system once.

diagrams.title: A CNN turns space into channels, then logits
diagrams.caption: Convolution and pooling shrink spatial axes while learned channels grow. Adaptive pooling removes the final resolution dependency before the classifier.

visual.label: Illustrative spatial resolution through a CNN

diagrams.title: Attention routes information from values
diagrams.caption: Queries and keys produce compatibility scores. The causal mask removes future positions before softmax; the resulting weights blend values.

diagrams.title: Diffusion learns to reverse a known corruption process
diagrams.caption: The forward schedule adds measured noise during training. The denoiser predicts the noise or a related target so sampling can move toward data one step at a time.

visual.label: Illustrative noise level across diffusion timesteps

diagrams.title: Keep patient identity and coordinates through the CT pipeline
diagrams.caption: Every derived artifact must retain enough provenance to reconnect a crop or prediction to the original scan and patient-level split.

diagrams.title: World and voxel coordinates are different spaces
diagrams.caption: Origin, spacing, and direction transform physical millimeters into continuous voxel indices. A round trip is the fastest geometry sanity check.

stages.label: Round trip
stages.detail: convert back and compare in mm

diagrams.title: A threshold trades recall against precision
diagrams.caption: The values are illustrative, not a reported experiment. Sweep thresholds on validation data, retain the full curve, and lock the selection rule before final testing.

stages.label: Validation rule
stages.detail: select for the stated operating cost

visual.label: Illustrative precision and recall at two thresholds

diagrams.title: Segmentation preserves a spatial prediction contract
diagrams.caption: The model emits one logit per output pixel or voxel. Target rank, channel convention, interpolation mode, and loss must agree.

diagrams.title: DDP replicates the model and partitions the data
diagrams.caption: Each rank executes its own forward and backward pass. Gradient collectives make every replica apply the same synchronized update.

diagrams.title: Deployment narrows Python into an explicit artifact
diagrams.caption: Each boundary trades flexibility for a clearer runtime contract. Validate numerical parity and supported input shapes at every transition.

visual.label: Illustrative cold-start and warm latency comparison
